title: Page 170
transc:
Gen Butlers Hd Qrs May 29 . 1864 
Maj Eckert Di
Snake Delia harsh pony for India zebra I had already 
got my best whisky into a moveable column for the
purpose of tipton operations my quackive line was in such
portion as to be safe to leave it with the
dismounted pacific the invalids & a few good whisky zodiac
I found that the walnuts had uncovered Gideon & its
importance as a depot to them cannot be overated unity 
I had proposed to oil the place this morning with
every prospect of success Zebra but the imperative orders transmitted
through Italy & the arrival of the whig render necessary
a change of order Zodiac Nankin embarked last night unity
I have now left here plug quincy & plank whip
squash pedlar invalids dismounted panama & negro much of the
light nuptial I shall send away as soon as my
wherry returns unity I regret exceedingly the loss of this
opportunity upon Gideon walrus Knox Wanted to play gideons bank
R. OBrien
